source:
@@U02410@@
The scoundrel! How much he promises, how little he delivers!

@@U02412@@
It’s clear, Herald, you're good at announcing masks, but it’s not a herald’s courtly duty to delve beneath the surface. That requires a sharper vision. But I have no quarrel with you. It is to you, my lord, I will address my questions.

@@U02413@@
(He turns to 普路托斯.)

@@U02414@@
Wasn't it to me you entrusted the whirlwind speed of your chariot? And have I not successfully guided it for you? Driven it well? To where you've directed? Have I not in bold flight soared aloft to win for you the palm of victory? Have I ever fought for you and failed? And if a laurel wreath adorns your brow, wasn't it | who wove it with wit and dedication?

@@U02416@@
If it is for me to bear witness to your good character, then I happily acknowledge that you are spirit of my spirit. Your every deed mirrors my will, and you are far richer than I. I prize above all my crowns the laurel I now reward you with, and I declare freely to all: You are my belovéd son; in you I am well pleased.
translation:
@@U02410@@
恶棍！他的承诺有多少，他兑现的却很少！

@@U02412@@
很明显，先驱报，你很擅长宣布面具，但深入表面之下并不是先驱者的礼貌职责。这需要更敏锐的眼光。但我与你并无争吵。陛下，我将向您解答我的问题。

@@U02413@@
（他转向普路托斯。）

@@U02414@@
你不正是将战车的旋风速度托付给了我吗？我还没有成功地给你引导过吗？开得好吗？去往你所指的地方？我不是奋勇飞翔，为你赢得胜利的手掌吗？我是否曾为你而奋斗却失败过？如果你的额头上戴着月桂花环，不是吗？谁用智慧和奉献精神编织了它？

@@U02416@@
如果让我来见证你的良好品格，那么我很高兴地承认你是我的灵魂之灵。你的一举一动都反映了我的意志，你比我富有得多。我现在奖励给你的桂冠胜过我所有的王冠，我自由地向所有人宣布：你是我心爱的儿子；你是我的儿子。我对你很满意。
